sentiment.rationale: The company reported strong organic growth in net revenue (beia) of 9.4% and beer volume growth of 4.7%, with all regions growing. However, management explicitly stated that the economic environment remains 'challenging and uncertain' and that they 'cannot extrapolate the reported top-line growth to the rest of the year,' while reaffirming unchanged full-year guidance. This indicates genuine operational momentum but no formal guidance raise, and the cautious forward language tempers the score.

summary.revenue: Revenue €8,184 million, up 7.2% (reported). Net revenue (beia) €6,847 million, up 9.4% organically.
summary.guidance: Full-year outlook unchanged: operating profit (beia) expected to grow organically low- to high-single-digit; net profit (beia) organic growth lower than operating profit (beia) organic growth.
summary.margin: Net revenue (beia) per hectolitre up 4.9% organically; price mix on a constant geographic basis increased by 6.0%.
